episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: A divorced contractor and a widowed beautician impulsively marry, but their broods are in no mood to meld.

episodes.name: The Dance
episodes.overview: Al is in the dumps after being dumped by a boy, so who's to undump her but lovable Steve Urkel.

episodes.name: Rules of the House
episodes.overview: Carol's new house rules are meant to bring harmony, but they drum up howls instead.

episodes.name: First Anniversary
episodes.overview: The newlyweds' one-month anniversary is marked by a misunderstanding over gifts and the arrival of Frank's nephew.

episodes.name: Frank & Son
episodes.overview: Frank's in a lather: J.T. doesn't seem cut out for carpentry, but he bubbles as Carol's shampoo boy.

episodes.name: Pulling Together
episodes.overview: Frank's kids are eager to compete in the rowdy Family Games--and Carol's are happy to let them.

episodes.name: Yo-Yo's Wedding
episodes.overview: Frank and Carol aren't clowning around when they retie the knot--at Brendan's birthday party.

episodes.name: Just for Kicks
episodes.overview: Dana sneaks out to hear her favorite singer at a bikers bar.

episodes.name: Into the Woods
episodes.overview: Camping in the wilderness proves too much for Carol to bear.

episodes.name: Mixed Messages
episodes.overview: An answering machine can be a lifesaver, but Karen doesn't get the message and, as a result, neither does Frank.

episodes.name: A Day in the Life
episodes.overview: While discussing families on TV, the Lamberts and Fosters are told to forget the cameras and just be themselves--and unfortunately they do.

episodes.name: The New Car
episodes.overview: J.T. "borrows" Carol's car for a date, and someone "borrows" it from him; Penny dates a mortician who likes to talk shop at dinner.

episodes.name: Getting Organized
episodes.overview: Frank and Carol end up in a dumpster in search of the files Carol dumped; Dana and Karen pull a UFO trick on Cody and J.T.

episodes.name: Home Alone
episodes.overview: Frank and Carol plan a weekend at a quiet retreat while Dana minds the kids at home. Is that how it works? No.

episodes.name: Drive, He Said
episodes.overview: Dana passes her driving test with flying colors, but Frank flunks his.

episodes.name: Bully for Mark
episodes.overview: Mark is doing the homework for a bully named Max; what's worse, Max is short for Maxine.

episodes.name: The Boys in the Band
episodes.overview: J.T. and Cody are dragged into replacing two of the four flu-stricken members of Al's all-girl rock band.

episodes.name: School Daze
episodes.overview: Carol returns to college as a student, but she's also a committed mother, wife, and beautician, and soon everyone's ready to be committed.

episodes.name: Country Club
episodes.overview: A country-club invitation works out nicely for everyone but Dana, who could club Frank over his hayseed ways.

episodes.name: Daddy's Girl
episodes.overview: Frank's dad, a widower, has a girlfriend who's a lot like Frank's mom--except she's a stripper.

episodes.name: He Wanted Wings
episodes.overview: Carol gives Frank flying lessons for his 40th birthday, and he gets a crash course when the instructor turns suicidal.

episodes.name: Beauty Contest
episodes.overview: Carol and Karen enter a beauty pageant at Frank's Mallard Lodge, but can't cope with the judges' foul behavior.
